title: Parabolic Anderson Model on Sierpinski Gasket
page_description: Interactive parabolic Anderson model simulation on the Sierpinski gasket.
model_caption: One realization of the Itô parabolic Anderson model with Neumann boundary conditions. The initial condition places one unit of mass at x₀.
equation_accessible_text: The time derivative of u equals kappa times the Neumann gasket Laplacian of u plus lambda times u times space-time white noise.
